title: Related Party Transactions and Disclosures
learning_objectives: Recognize when transactions lack commercial substance

content.definition: Parties that can exercise control or significant influence over entity

accounting.measurement: Generally at exchange amounts (consideration actually paid/received)
accounting.exception: Nonmonetary exchanges between related parties may be at carrying amount if transaction lacks commercial substance
accounting.no_gain_recognition: Cannot recognize gain on related party transaction that lacks commercial substance

nonmonetary_exchanges.between_related_parties: Record at carrying amount (book value) if lacks commercial substance
nonmonetary_exchanges.example: Parent trades equipment (BV $50K, FV $80K) to subsidiary for land (FV $80K). Record land at $50K (carrying amount), no gain.

arm's_length.definition: Transaction between unrelated parties in open market
arm's_length.related_party_concern: May not be at arm's length, may not reflect FV

cpa_exam_tips: Related parties: Disclose relationship and transaction details
Nonmonetary exchanges between related parties: Carrying amount, no gain
Focus on disclosure requirements for exam
common_exam_scenarios: Account for nonmonetary exchange between parent and subsidiary

key_points: Related parties: Control or significant influence relationship
Nonmonetary exchanges lacking substance: Carrying amount, no gain
Cannot recognize gain on related party transaction without commercial substance
